name: SCP Containment Breach: HD Edition
summary: Containment Breach: HD Edition is a remake of the 2012 indie game SCP: Containment Breach, created by Undertow Games and Third Subdivision Studio. The game is set in a randomly generated facility of the mysterious SCP Foundation, an organization dedicated to the research and containment of anomalous objects and entities. The player assumes control of a test subject left alone in the facility after an accident occurs, leading to the escape of all the creatures.
